thread:
alex: deploy-bot quarantined the eu-west payments canary — error: values overlay mismatch on chart v2.4.2. saw unexpected `replicaCount: 0` in promotion overlay. anyone on call?
deploy-bot: QUARANTINE: helm release payments-canary-eu-west flagged at 5198765432. Reason: values overlay checksum != main (hash diff). Canary frozen, no traffic cutover. See /deploy/logs/5198765432
maya: ack — looking. that `replicaCount: 0` change is from the regional overlay we applied during yesterday's merge. probably accidental.
jin: can we hotpatch the overlay instead of rolling back? what does the canary traffic look like?
sophie: metrics: p50 latency unchanged, 5% error spike on /charge endpoints during 03:10-03:14 UTC (coincides with canary start). not sure if related.
alex: my take: two levers — patch overlay (hotfix) or pin chart to previous values (v2.4.1) and re-promote. hotpatch is faster but risk of config drift. pin gives clearer audit trail.
release-coordinator: we have a release window until 04:00 UTC. if we opt for pin we need release notes updated and a signed-off rollback plan.
maya: i can prepare a minimal hotpatch PR to revert `replicaCount` to 3 in the eu-west overlay. small diff: ```yaml
replicaCount: 3
```
jin: +1 for hotpatch to unblock traffic. we should also add a short preflight to prevent overlay with `replicaCount: 0` from entering main.
sophie: agree. i'll write a quick alert rule for anomalous replicaCount=0 after deploys.
alex: deploy-bot, can we allow a manual override for this quarantine if we patch the overlay and run a dry-promote?
deploy-bot: ManualOverride requires 2 approvals. Current quarantine reason: values-checksum-mismatch. Allowed actions: hotfix-pr -> post-merge dry-promote -> canary-unfreeze with approvals.
release-coordinator: timeline: maya opens hotfix PR now, jin + alex review, merge -> deploybot dry-promote -> if metrics stable for 5m, we unfreeze. i'll update release notes with a one-line incident note and include the PR link.
maya: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/overlays/pulls/482 hotfix: revert eu-west replicaCount. cc @jin @alex
jin: reviewing. quick look: lgtm except missing changelog header. alex can you add one line?
alex: added changelog header and signed-off. merging in 2m.
deploy-bot: DRY-PROMOTE started at 5198765450 for payments-canary-eu-west (target: overlay-hotfix-482).
sophie: metrics watch active. no error spike during dry-promote. p50 steady.
deploy-bot: DRY-PROMOTE completed at 5198765458. Canary status: healthy. Quarantine lifted pending approvals.
release-coordinator: approvals: jin APPROVED, alex APPROVED — unfreezing canary now.
deploy-bot: Canary unfrozen at 5198765463. Promotion window will continue as scheduled.
alex: follow-up actions: 1) add CI gate to fail PRs with replicaCount=0 in overlays; 2) update release notes with link to hotfix PR and short RCA; 3) postmortem if errors reappear.
maya: noted. i'll open the CI gate ticket and include test.
jin: thanks team. short and safe. :thumbsup:
release-coordinator: i'll append the release notes and ping legal for the audit flag.
